name: devrank
description: AI-powered technical candidate evaluation and ranking system

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @devrank/contracts && concurrently -k -n web,api -c cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace @devrank/web" "npm run dev --workspace @devrank/api"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace @devrank/contracts && npm run dev --workspace @devrank/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace @devrank/contracts && npm run dev --workspace @devrank/api
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @devrank/contracts && npm run build --workspace @devrank/api && npm run build --workspace @devrank/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @devrank/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @devrank/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @devrank/web
